shared_elements: dense field of inscribed script signs
justification: Both surfaces are essentially inscriptions: a rectangular field covered with rows of repeated script signs, which is the only real correspondence and a very generic one. A's text runs as continuous horizontal lines of small linear signs filling the whole panel, whereas B is a bordered composition of large rounded pictorial glyph blocks framing an empty centre dominated by a big hatched disc with paired small signs around it — no such disc, border scheme or glyph form appears in A.
